title: explain_rules input
description: Why does this need X? Returns the engine's rule trace for one record: which rule groups matched, which single most specific group won and which broader groups dropped out, the gate policy row, the separation rules and the flags. The engine re-runs the evaluation in read mode against the configuration set version stamped on the record. Writes nothing.

subjectId.description: The ID of the record, or the domain key for a data domain.

aspects.description: Only these aspects. Leave out for all.

version.description: Explain against this version. Leave out for the version stamped on the record.
